SUMMARY.md: Provides real-time information on available parking spaces in connected parking garages in cities like Basel, Zurich, Bern, Luzern, St.Gallen, and Zug. Developed by Simon Jenny for the Pebble.Parking-App. 2026-11-03: response schemas rewritten from a live probe: / answers {`api_version`, `server_version`, reference, cities} with cities a MAP keyed by city id (not an array), and /{city} answers {`last_updated`, `last_downloaded`, lots}; city example Basel (probed 200).
